The learner asks specifically: Make sure the senses include each of these meanings: the meal in the middle of the day; food eaten at one time.

notes: In Spain, 'la comida' refers specifically to the main midday meal, usually eaten between 2:00 and 4:00 PM. 'La cena' is used for the evening meal.
While 'comida' can mean 'food' in general, when someone asks '¿Qué hay de comida?', they are usually asking about the menu for lunch.
